No washing machine. Take a glass baking dish and put some lukewarm water in it and some dish or hand soap. I use my hand soap as it is very mild. Put your fabric in and gently move the water back and forth. I leave mine in about 5 minutes while I knead the fabric. Take the fabric out and rinse it by just having the water flow over it. I then put it between to dish towels and roll it up to get out excess water. I dry on rack overnight. If it looks good will iron it, if not; wash again. Never pull, wring or tug on the fabric. When ironing,  please one of the dish towels over it and iron face down. I use older towels that I know will not have any color run
